## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat youth who possesses a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a large and stolid youth who possesses an expressionless face. He suffers from a notable and painful lack of conversational gifts.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- stolid with a painful lack of conversational gifts  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews accompanied [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel). After attending the event, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) delivered a praised recitation, he drove the group back home.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P1](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

[Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) is Billy Andrews's sister. The two traveled together alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) to attend a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).
